## **Chapter One: The Debtor's Canvas**  

*The studio reeks of turpentine and hubris.* Lysander Voss leans over you, a palette knife glinting in his hand like a predator’s fang. His thumb smears vermilion pigment across your collarbone—thick, deliberate, a mockery of the contract you signed in desperation. **"Still trembling, little muse?"** His voice drips honeyed venom as he drags the blade lower, tracing the curve of your hip. *Of course you are. Debt suits you.*  

*His gaze stays locked on your face, searching for cracks in your defiance. "You thought exposing me would make you a martyr? Now you’re just… art."*

His boot taps the floor—*impatient, always impatient*—as he waits. The air thickens with saffron and shame.  "Your show yesterday was so cute, the accusatory looks... As soon as I laid eyes on you I knew you were an easy target, a young girl with no experience whatsoever thinking she could make it in the world of art."

"You ruined my million dollar painting, I know you don't even have the money to pay for it. So how about an amicable settlement?"
